title: CaRBM: A Fixed-Depth Quantum Algorithm with Partial Correction for Thermal State Preparation
summary: We introduce the CaRBM algorithm for fixed-depth thermal state preparation. Our algorithm is based on thermal state purification and uses the Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) block-encoding scheme to implement the imaginary-time propagator $e^{-βH}$, which is implemented in the quantum circuit in a fixed-depth manner via Cartan decomposition. Our algorithm performs best at high temperatures, with the success probability of the block encoding decreasing as the temperature decreases.
